patterns.note: Content is primarily presented in centered blocks with generous vertical spacing, often featuring full-width image carousels or simple grid layouts for artworks and locations.

A sophisticated serif typeface is used for prominent headings and branding, creating an elegant and established feel, while a clean, neutral sans-serif is used for navigation, body text, and smaller labels.
A high-contrast monochrome palette of black and white forms the base, allowing the diverse and often vibrant colors of the displayed artworks to serve as the primary visual accents.

The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport, and the hero section features a full-bleed image carousel where images slide horizontally behind a fixed, centrally positioned text overlay.
Content is organized into distinct sections, each introduced by a centered, uppercase sans-serif label, followed by either a grid of images or detailed text blocks.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header that remains fixed at the top of the viewport without changing size or style on scroll.
Create a full-bleed hero section with a horizontal image carousel (e.g., using Swiper.js) where the images slide behind a fixed, centrally positioned text overlay.
Structure content into distinct sections, each introduced by a centered, uppercase text label, followed by a grid layout for images or detailed text blocks.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant serif headings (~2.5x body) with clean, smaller sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced to airy, with a very airy hero section and consistent gutters in image grids.

standout: The site's standout feature is its sophisticated, gallery-like minimalism. It uses a classic serif typeface for its main branding and announcements, which immediately conveys an air of prestige and tradition, while keeping the rest of the UI extremely clean and unobtrusive. This deliberate restraint ensures that the diverse and often vibrant artworks are the undisputed focal point.
